label: Reolink RLC-811A
description: Reolink RLC-811A is an 8 MP 4K PoE bullet camera with a 2.7-13.5 mm motorised 5x optical zoom lens, five 6500 K spotlights for colour night vision, person/vehicle/animal detection, a siren and two-way audio. It presents one 10/100 Mbps RJ45 port fed by 802.3af active PoE (48 V) or a 12 VDC 1 A input, and this PoE model has no Wi-Fi radio.
notes: From Reolink's own specification page: Ethernet 'One 10M/100Mbps; RJ45'; Power 'PoE IEEE 802.3af, 48V active' or 'DC 12.0V 1A'; microSD slot to 512 GB; two-way audio; spotlight 5pcs/4W/6500K/450 lumens; interface list is power DC port, reset button, Ethernet, waterproof lid - no antenna. Not confirmed: Reolink publishes no power-consumption figure and no 802.3af class, so the 12.95 W in poeIn is the 802.3af Type 1 PSE allocation rather than a measured draw; treat it as an upper bound for planning. Reolink's own FAQ warns the injector must be 802.3af-compliant 48 V active - a passive 24 V injector will not bring it up. The wireless sibling is a different SKU, so on this model the cable is the only path.
